summary: Set the code Node will use for graceful process termination without forcing immediate exit.

requirements.assignment_value: runtime value checked with modern Node exit-code validation

semantics.accepted: integer number, integer string, null, or undefined according to modern Node semantics
semantics.precedence: a later explicit process.exit(code) overrides the stored code

caveats: A C# integer property cannot preserve undefined/null/integer-string observable states.
